notices.text: this message continued past midnight and is included in January 17.

messages.en: Hellooo!!
I’m here!
Did you see the 20-person Signal…?
우핳
I was really surprised.
They said, “We’re going to film New Year’s greetings.”
That’s what they told us,
so I thought, “Oh, I guess that’s what we’re doing.”
Since they were already filming from the elevator,
I thought, “Oh, something’s up here” ㅋㅋ
I did have that thought, though.
I didn’t think it would actually happen.
Oh wow.
But seeing everyone in person,
everyone was even prettier.
It felt like I was inside Signal.
For the first time, I…
tried pushing my bangs back a little.
How is it??
I thought we were just going to film the greeting,
so I thought I’d try showing my forehead today,
and just gave it a try,
If I’d known it was going to be such an important occasion…
The day before filming,
I was saying, “I’ll start dieting tomorrow~,”
and my puffy cheeks are still going strong ㅋ
Everyone was really so pretty…
But even though I’m not usually shy around people,

messages.ko: 상황이 상황인지라 쉽게 잘 못친해지는거 같아요
messages.en: I think it’s hard to get close to people easily, given the circumstances.
🌊 They say your cheeks aren’t chubby at all in person. That’s what Sohyun said.
That’s Sohyun’s verdict.
Oh, really? Sohyun unnie talked about me?😍😍
훟헤ㅔ
I’m excited.
Sohyun unnie,
Sohyun unnie looks even more handsome in person.
